candidate.definition_en: A hard, lustrous spherical mass, typically white, formed within the shell of an oyster.
candidate.explanation_ar: حجر كريم لونه أبيض وبيلمع بيطلع من المحار في البحر، وغالي جداً.

senses.definition_en: A hard, lustrous spherical mass, typically white, formed within the shell of an oyster.
senses.definition_ar: لؤلؤة؛ جسم صلب لامع يتكون داخل صدفة المحار ويستخدم في المجوهرات والحلي.
examples: The diver found a rare black pearl.
Her wisdom was a pearl of great price in our troubled times.
The diver found a rare black pearl.
Her wisdom was a pearl of great price in our troubled times.
candidate.mnemonic: افتكر 'Pearl Harbor'.. الميناء اللي فيه 'Pearl' لؤلؤ.
